meta.purpose: Active queer groups only - no closed groups
meta.notes: Verified via last event date, website status, IG activity. Oregon State Leather Contest renamed from Blackout Leather Productions in 2021. Portland Leather Alliance verified active 2025 with Consent in Kink class Feb 18 2025 and Black and Blue Nov 30 2025. PDX PAH socials page confirms IG/X/Bluesky/FB active. Pink Ponies IG @burningmanpinkponies active. Black & Beyond Binary active at 5633 SE Division. Darklady Productions appears closed (last corp filing 2002, no events since 2012). Oregon Bears site dead, only ellgeeBE stub.

active_groups.name: Pink Ponies
active_groups.about: A diverse collection of kind and welcoming queer-identifying campers at Burning Man. 501(c)(3) nonprofit, no one compensated. Ethical creative expression, sex positivity, gender fluidity, radical inclusion.

provenance.how_found: Humanitix Pink Ponies Present: SLEIGH / Heart On pages - footer says follow on Instagram @burningmanpinkponies

active_groups.name: PDX PAH - Portland Pets & Handlers
active_groups.about: Group devoted to human-pet play and people who love it. Education and community in Portland for pets, pups, handlers and curious. Biggest events monthly social and mosh hosted by Eagle in North Portland. Welcomes all shapes, sizes, colors, genders, orientations.

provenance.how_found: pdxpah.com + pdxpah.com/socials page lists IG, X, Bluesky, FB

active_groups.name: Oregon State Leather Contest
active_groups.new_link_note: Old domain blackoutleather.org dead. Now operates via Squarespace application forms + Instagram. Legal name changed from Blackout Leather Productions to Oregon State Leather Contest in 2021 per Wikipedia.
active_groups.about: Largest leather title contest in Oregon since 1997. Celebrates BDSM, Leather, Pup/Pet, Mx. 501c3. Draws contestants from Oregon + SW Washington. Formerly Blackout Leather Productions.

provenance.how_found: Wikipedia confirms 2021 name change from Blackout to Oregon State Leather Contest

active_groups.name: Portland Leather Alliance
active_groups.about: All-volunteer 501(c)3 formed 1998, education and awareness of alternative lifestyles. Largest membership based BDSM org in Portland Metro + SW Washington. Presents Consent in Kink, KinkFest April 18-20 2025.

provenance.how_found: Search PLA - Feb 18 2025 Consent class + Nov 30 2025 Black and Blue + 2025-2026 board
provenance.source_url: https://www.pdxsanctuary.com/ - PLA CLASS: Consent in Kink

active_groups.name: Bad Girls PDX
active_groups.about: Kinky women's group - BDSM Safety & Etiquette class + new member orientation at Q Center 4115 N Mississippi
active_groups.address: Q Center, 4115 N Mississippi Ave, Portland OR 97217

provenance.how_found: Just Out listings + pdxbadgirls.net still resolves

active_groups.name: Black & Beyond the Binary Collective
active_groups.about: Builds leadership, healing, safety for Black-African transgender, queer, nonbinary, two-spirit, intersex (TQN2SI+) Oregonians. Envisions future that gives power back, celebrates self-expression.
active_groups.address: 5633 SE Division St, Portland OR 97206, SE Uplift at Tabor Commons

provenance.how_found: Idealist + Transponder + Queer Social Club Black Pride Kickback

active_groups.name: Brown Girl Rise
active_groups.about: 501(c)(3) radical sisterhood of girls and non-binary youth of global majority reclaiming connection to body, community, land, health, creativity. Summer camps, menstrual kit actions, zine workshops.

provenance.how_found: browngirlriseportland.org Who We Are + Reed Quest spotlight

active_groups.name: TranzGuys PDX
active_groups.about: Inclusive peer-support/discussion/social group for those AFAB who now identify otherwise: trans, MTO, genderfluid, transman, genderqueer, boi, FTM, male, butch, two-spirit etc. 3rd Sunday 6-8pm Q Center.

active_groups.name: Ori Gallery
active_groups.about: One of few galleries in world dedicated to QTBIPOC works, teaches art + activism workshops, fundraisers for Black and trans causes

active_groups.name: Portland Frontrunners
active_groups.about: Running/walking club for LGBTQIA+ and friends, hosts annual Portland Pride Run & Walk + Bridge to Bridge

active_groups.name: Lavender League
active_groups.about: Portland-based soccer league for queer women and nonbinary or trans people, 200+ members as of 2025

active_groups.name: PDX Gaymers
active_groups.about: Queer gamers - screenings, board games, socials

active_groups.name: Sankofa Collective
active_groups.about: Formerly Portland African-American/Black PFLAG, promotes health and well-being of gay, lesbian, bisexual and transgender persons, their families and friends

provenance.how_found: PSU Queer and Trans Student of Color Resources
